parts.html: The K-19 kitchen is a modern straight kitchen 3.1 linear meters long with solid beige fronts. It suits an apartment, a serviced apartment, or a small house when you need a full work zone with roomy cabinets but do not want to crowd the room.
Beige is a soft, warm color that goes well with light walls, wood, ceramic tile, and stone-effect surfaces. The fronts are solid, with no pattern, so the kitchen does not draw attention to itself.
Everything you need for cooking is along one wall. The rest of the room is free for a dining table, a walkway, or a living area, which is convenient when the kitchen is open to the living space.

The kitchen is 3.1 m long. The positions of the sink, cooktop, refrigerator, and other built-in appliances, as well as the cabinet interiors, are worked out at the design stage to the dimensions of your room.
The upper and lower fronts of the K-19 are laminated chipboard in one beige color, with no contrasting inserts. The carcass is 18 mm laminated chipboard.
The hinged doors hang on Muller soft-close hinges and close smoothly; the drawers run on concealed Muller slides. Handles are included.
We fit the K-19 to the length of your wall, the location of the utility connections, and the appliances you choose.
